sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854, Data Act
sources.timing: Generally applies from 12 September 2025. Article 3(1) applies to connected products and related services placed on the market after 12 September 2026. Chapter IV (unfair contractual terms, including Article 13) applies to contracts concluded after 12 September 2025, and from 12 September 2027 to contracts concluded on or before 12 September 2025 that are of indefinite duration or due to expire at least 10 years from 11 January 2024 (Article 50).

sources.title: Directive 2006/42/EC, Machinery Directive
sources.timing: Current EU machinery framework during the synthetic 2026 review, implemented through national law. Applies until 19 January 2027: repealed with effect from 20 January 2027 by Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Article 51(2) (date as corrected by the corrigendum of 4 July 2023). Products placed on the market in conformity with the Directive before 20 January 2027 may continue to be made available (Article 52(1) of that Regulation).

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Machinery Regulation
sources.timing: Generally applies from 20 January 2027 (Article 54). Articles 26 to 42 apply from 20 January 2024. As amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (EU-AI-ACT-AMENDMENT), Article 8 requires Commission delegated acts adding health and safety requirements to Annex III for AI systems classified as high-risk under Article 6(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as a safety component of, or as, a product covered by this Regulation. Those delegated acts are to apply by 2 August 2028.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, Artificial Intelligence Act
sources.timing: Generally applies from 2 August 2026. As amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (EU-AI-ACT-AMENDMENT), Chapter III, Sections 1 to 3 (except Article 6(5)) apply from 2 December 2027 for high-risk AI systems under Article 6(2) and Annex III, and from 2 August 2028 for high-risk AI systems under Article 6(1) and Annex I (Article 113(c)). The Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 is now listed in Annex I Section B. For a high-risk AI system under Article 6(1) related to machinery, only Article 6(1), Article 60a and Articles 102 to 112 apply, and Articles 57 to 59 apply only once the high-risk requirements are integrated into the Machinery Regulation (Article 2(2)); those requirements reach machinery through delegated acts under Article 8 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230. Other phases under Article 113 must be checked separately.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
sources.pinpoint: Amendments relevant here: Articles 2(2) and 113 and Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689; Articles 8, 20 and 47 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230
sources.timing: Published in the Official Journal on 24 July 2026 and in force from 27 July 2026. Defers Chapter III, Sections 1 to 3 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 to 2 December 2027 (Annex III) and 2 August 2028 (Article 6(1), Annex I), removes the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC from Annex I Section A and lists the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 in Annex I Section B, and adds AI-specific delegated acts to Article 8 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230. Effects checked against the consolidated texts of both Regulations as of 27 July 2026; confirm against the Official Journal text before external use.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847, Cyber Resilience Act
sources.timing: Chapter IV applies from 11 June 2026. Article 14 (reporting of actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents) applies from 11 September 2026, and under Article 69(3) also to products with digital elements placed on the market before 11 December 2027. Notifications go through the single reporting platform set up by ENISA under Article 16, operational since 11 September 2026. The Regulation generally applies from 11 December 2027 (Article 71).

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2024/2853, Product Liability Directive
sources.timing: Member States must transpose the Directive by 9 December 2026 (Article 22). It applies to products placed on the market or put into service after 8 December 2026 (Article 2(1), as corrected by the corrigendum of 7 May 2026); products placed on the market or put into service on or before that date are outside its scope.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, General Data Protection Regulation
sources.timing: In force and directly applicable. The concrete obligations depend on the roles, data, purposes, and transfer path.
